items.exampleEn: After a difficult year, it's time to move on.
items.exampleZh: 經過艱難的一年，是時候繼續往前走了。

items.exampleEn: Could you print this file out for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我把這份檔案列印出來嗎？

items.exampleEn: Shopping around takes time, but it's often worth it.
items.exampleZh: 貨比三家很花時間，但通常很值得。

items.exampleEn: Our school stocks up on paper every August.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校每年八月都會囤一批紙。

items.exampleEn: The speaker summed up quickly and sat down.
items.exampleZh: 講者很快地做了總結，然後坐下。

items.exampleEn: This table is easy to take apart.
All forms must be turned in today.
items.exampleZh: 所有表格今天都必須繳交。

items.sentenceEn: We shopped around for a week before choosing a sofa.
items.sentenceZh: 我們貨比三家了一週，才選定一張沙發。

items.audioEn: I'm really tired, so I think I'll turn in early tonight.
items.audioZh: 我真的好累，所以今晚應該會早點睡。
items.questionZh: 說話者今晚打算做什麼？
options: Go out for dinner with some friends
Finish the report before going to bed
Go to sleep earlier than usual

items.sentenceEn: Let's move on to the next question.
items.sentenceZh: 我們進入下一個問題吧。

items.sentenceEn: He took the old radio apart to see how it worked.
items.sentenceZh: 他把那台舊收音機拆開，想看看它是怎麼運作的。

items.stemEn: Before the meeting, please ____ ten copies of the report.
items.stemZh: 開會前，請把報告列印十份出來。

items.stemEn: Before the long weekend, many families ____ food and drinks.
items.stemZh: 長週末之前，很多家庭都會囤積食物和飲料。

items.passageEn: At the end of the term, Daniel had a busy week. On Monday, he finished his final report, which summed up a month of research on local birds, and turned it in. Then he had to buy a new laptop, because his old one had stopped working. He compared prices online and in three stores before finding a good one at a fair price. By Friday, he was ready to move on to his summer job at a camp.
items.passageZh: 學期末，Daniel 過了忙碌的一週。星期一，他完成了期末報告並交了出去，報告總結了他一個月來對當地鳥類的研究。接著他得買一台新筆電，因為舊的那台壞了。他在網路上和三家店比較價格，才找到一台價錢合理的好筆電。到了星期五，他已經準備好去營隊做暑期工作了。

questions.questionZh: Daniel 的報告內容是什麼？
Daniel 為什麼要買新筆電？
options: 學校送的折價券快過期了

items.promptZh: 請用三句話總結這篇文章。
referenceEn: Please sum up this article in three sentences.
Please sum this article up in three sentences.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「總結」（例如 sum up this article、sum this article up 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 summarize this article 等）
「用三句話」可寫，例如 in three sentences 等

items.promptZh: 別再想那次考試了，往前看吧。
referenceEn: Stop thinking about that exam and move on.
Don't think about that test anymore; just move on.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「往前看」（例如 move on 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 let it go、forget about it、look forward 等）
「別再想」可寫，例如 stop thinking about、don't think about … anymore 等
